description:
Etkin is an event management platform for associations, NGOs, universities and communities. This plugin lets organization admins ask about their events in plain language.

What you can do:
• Get a dashboard summary, list your events and view event details
• See registrations, attendance rate and check-ins for an event
• Get a full performance report for a single event, or a period summary for your organization
• See survey results (closed-ended questions only)
• See email delivery reports and an event's financial summary
• Preview how many people a reminder would reach
• Generate an AI event draft, or create a new event as a draft (never published automatically)

Privacy by design:
• No tool returns attendee names, email addresses or phone numbers
• Survey distributions are hidden when fewer than 5 people answered; written (open-ended) answers are never returned
• You only ever see your own organization's data

Publishing an event and scheduling reminder emails require an explicit in-chat confirmation. If the confirmation cannot be shown, the tool makes no change and links you to the Etkin dashboard instead.

Requires an Etkin account with an organization admin role.
